description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named 'Screen' within the OrangeHRM project. It encapsulates properties and methods related to a user interface screen, including its name, associated module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator. The class includes a constructor for instantiating a screen object, and a static method 'createFromArray' to construct an instance from an array containing configuration data.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a UI screen with associated metadata and permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a Screen instance from a given array of data, including permissions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the screen.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator setting for the screen, if any.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of permissions associated with the screen.
